reviews.title: Happy! Every day office use with 1 monitor.
reviews.comment:
I purchased the SAMSUNG 49-inch Odyssey G9 (G91F) DQHD, 144Hz Curved Gaming Monitor for everyday office use to replace three separate monitors across my desk. Until I switched to the Odyssey, I truly didn’t realize what I was missing.
The curve is perfect and greatly improves my viewing angle. I have ongoing neck and shoulder issues, and this monitor provides a much more natural and comfortable viewing experience compared to using three individual screens. I’m especially happy to no longer deal with monitor bezels breaking up my workspace. I can resize applications freely and still read everything clearly within each window.
I often work with three different applications visible at the same time while developing and troubleshooting in an EMR system, and this monitor handles that workflow beautifully. Everything feels more streamlined and efficient.
Packaging was impressive and well thought out, and assembly was very easy. Overall, this monitor has significantly improved both my comfort and productivity, and I would highly recommend it for anyone looking to replace multiple monitors with a single, seamless display—especially for office or professional use.
reviews.author: non

reviews.title: 49 inches of beautiful, curved slab of unbroken visual real estate
reviews.comment:
This monitor is 4 feet wide, providing the horizontal resolution of almost three regular monitors side by side, but with no bezel gaps. The 1m radius means that every spot on the screen is nearly the same distance to your eyes.
While this is excellent for gaming, giving a field of view you've never had before, it's pretty great for regular working as well. You can put a window anywhere you want without the span gap of separate monitors.
The only minor nit I have is it's not technically IPS. But it's still quite bright and doesn't suffer the color inaccuracies and inversions typical of other non-IPS (and non-OLED) monitors.
Performance wise, I am chuffed!
